$comment: ADR-023 action-authorization matrix seed. Each entry maps a dot-separated action name to an array of group IDs allowed to invoke it. The special 'admin' group means Nextcloud admins; admins always pass regardless. Empty array or ['admin'] means admin-only. Admins broaden access via Admin Settings > PetStore > Actions without a code change. The single 'order.cancel' entry below is the worked example wired end-to-end (route order#cancel -> OrderController::cancel -> ActionAuthService::requireAction) for apps copying this template; add one entry per requireAction() call site as the app grows.
